mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Read the source code or metadata of any ABAP object: class, program, CDS view, table, function module, package and more.

description: [read-only] Reads one part of the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …). part selects it: source (default) the source alone, in one request; metadata the ADT metadata document alone, in one request; urls (SERVICE_BINDING) the service URL, its $metadata and the browser preview, contents (PACKAGE) the objects the package holds, its walk read level by level in ADT batch envelopes; package_names lists several packages, read together, one entry per package in the order given. A source document answers { part: 'source', source } and a metadata document { part: 'metadata', metadata }, beside the object's name. Parts per type: PACKAGE metadata, contents; DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP metadata; LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, TRANSPORT, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST source; SERVICE_BINDING source, metadata, urls; every other type source, metadata. A part outside the type's list is answered with that list. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure(object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions; one node level; a package's blank answer is the empty listing with blank stating its two readings: an empty package, or an unknown package name) and virtual_folders(object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by its id, in one request each: activation_status(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, status, document }, the run's status (finished, error, failed, or its progress while it runs) and its status document as SAP answered it; activation_results(run_id*) answers { run_id, part, messages, document }, the messages the run produced and its results document as SAP answered it. Otherwise object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*). TRANSPORT answers the objects a task holds, each with its position in the task's object list; for a request, every task's entries, each once, with its task number and position. UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST read the run's result in one request and answer { success, run_id, run_result }, run_result the result document SAP answered, parsed. Valid once the status is FINISHED; a finished run's result carries executionTime. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. When part is source (absent reads as source) and object_type is one of TRANSPORT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or part is metadata and object_type is one of PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or part is object_structure; or part is node_structure and object_adt_type is given; or part is virtual_folders; or part is activation_status and run_id is given; or part is activation_results and run_id is given; or part is source (absent reads as source) and object_type is one of UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST and run_id is given, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

function_group_name.description: Function group name (FUNCTION_GROUP; FUNCTION_MODULE given as the module's name).

function_module_name.description: Function module name: GROUP|MODULE, its function group first, or the module alone with function_group_name.

include_descriptions.description: Include each member's description (part contents). The walk's levels are then read as single requests, several at a time, rather than in ADT batch envelopes.

max_results.description: Maximum number of members listed per package (part contents).

node_id.description: Node id to expand (node_structure); the root when absent.

object_adt_type.description: ADT type code of the object (object_structure) or of the parent node (node_structure).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

package_names.description: Several package names (part contents), read together: one entry per package, in the order given, each { package_name, contents } or { package_name, error }.

part.description: The part to read: source (the source alone), metadata (the ADT metadata document alone), urls (the service and preview URLs), contents (the objects a package holds); each object type answers the parts it has, and a part outside them is answered with the list of its parts. Three parts read the repository by ADT address: object_structure (object_adt_type*, object_name*), node_structure (object_adt_type*, object_name*, node_id, with_short_descriptions) and virtual_folders (object_search_pattern, preselection, facet_order, with_versions, ignore_short_descriptions). Two parts read an activation run by run_id*: activation_status (its status) and activation_results (the messages it produced).

run_id.description: Run id: a unit test run (UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST) or an activation run (parts activation_status, activation_results).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP. Applies to the repository reads: object_type PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, TRANSPORT, and the parts object_structure, node_structure, virtual_folders.

transport_number.description: Transport request or task number (TRANSPORT). A request lists the entries of all its tasks; a task lists its own.

name: HandlerGet
